prBodyNotes: Merging deploys nothing. Run `scripts/deploy.sh`, then `state.apply quadlets test=True` on the host before the real run; a changed tag restarts the containers that use it.

customManagers.description: Image tags in the quadlet pillars: a `{#- renovate: depName=<image> #}` comment directly above `{%- set <name>_version = '<tag>[@sha256:<digest>]' %}`.

packageRules.description: Internal registry, not reachable from GitHub-hosted runners.
InfluxDB 3 has a different storage engine and is no in-place upgrade from 2.x.
netboot.xyz tags look like 0.7.6-nbxyz26; the nbxyz number is a build, not a fixed suffix.
grafana-dev nightly builds are tagged <version>-<build id>.
haproxy: patch releases of the current branch as their own PR, apart from newer branches.
Immich server, valkey and postgres follow the docker-compose.yml of an Immich release.
prBodyNotes: Compare valkey and postgres with the docker-compose.yml of the new Immich release before merging: https://github.com/immich-app/immich/releases

packageRules.description: A new PostgreSQL major version needs a dump and restore of the Immich database.
The tika container's start command in the pillar is copied from the image.
prBodyNotes: Check that the image's entrypoint still matches the entrypoint/command override of the tika container in pillar/quadlets/server-01.sls.
